reports.name: Pinnularia viridis
reports.shape: Elongate rounded paired valves and a girdle wall surround two lateral green-brown plastid ribbons. Transverse relief leaves a central axial raphe/clear-region study.
reports.surface: Subdued paired silica skins and finer transverse relief replace an opaque cream disc. Two olive plastid ribbons and a central clear-region cue are original numeric surfaces, not a microscopy texture.
reports.remaining: The selected outline, chamber/raphe architecture, plastid folds, pores and central region are simplified. Silica appears like generic transparent glass and plastids like regular ribbons; LM optical contrast and dimensions are not reproduced or calibrated. The glide lacks measured substrate/raphe mechanics.

reports.name: Asterionella formosa
reports.shape: Eight long narrow heteropolar frustules radiate from enlarged foot-pole attachment cues. Separate paired silica walls and selected golden plastid bodies replace a thick opaque star.
reports.surface: Thin separate silica walls, unequal foot/head-pole outlines and selected golden intracellular cues replace a thick opaque star. Photographic background organisms are excluded from the species model.
reports.remaining: The eight-arm arrangement and inner attachment cluster remain too regular and partly overlap. Intracellular bodies are idealized, fine striae and mucilage ultrastructure are incomplete, and natural silica/illumination optics and dimensions are unmeasured. The low side/front views are inherently edge-on; drift is authored.

reports.name: Tabellaria flocculosa
reports.shape: Five septate frustules meet at corner attachment cues in a selected zigzag colony. Valves have a broad middle and capitate ends; girdle walls and internal septa remain visible.
reports.surface: Prepared-frustule presentation distinguishes centrally inflated capitate valves from rectangular septate girdle walls. Closed girdle-band and septum cues have original numeric surfaces without living plastid claims.
reports.remaining: Girdle-band count, rudimentary septa, rimoportulae and marginal spines are incomplete; corner geometry and valve ends remain idealized. Some close surfaces intersect or occlude internal bands. The source shows isolated cleaned frustules, not this measured colony or living optical appearance. Only whole-group external drift is illustrated.

reports.name: Melosira varians
reports.shape: Nine short cylindrical silica frustules join through circular valve margins. Numerous selected golden-brown plastid cues lie inside a subdued transparent envelope with small mantle-granule cues.
reports.surface: Transparent cylindrical skins and circular valve junctions reveal numerous selected golden plate-like plastid cues. Fine mantle granule cues replace a uniform opaque golden tube; no Aulacoseira-like coarse areolate pattern is applied.
reports.remaining: The chain remains regular; plastids are smooth ellipsoidal plates and some are visibly faceted at close scale. Fine valve/rimoportula/spine anatomy and junction attachment are incomplete; pigment and silica optics are uncalibrated. External drift is not motility or a flow calculation.

reports.name: Bacillaria paxillifera
reports.shape: Seven long linear, tapered-ended frustules form a close parallel colony. Paired plastid ribbons, fine transverse relief and an eccentric longitudinal raphe cue are distinct from the older opaque pointed strips.
reports.surface: Paired silica skins, fine transverse relief, an eccentric raphe cue and two selected folded plastid ribbons replace the old opaque pointed strips. The authentic live stack photograph is kept with exact attribution.
reports.remaining: Fine fibulae, interlocking structures and terminal raphe architecture remain incomplete; tips are still too idealized and plastids too regular. Constant lateral spacing and overlap are geometric constraints, not hook/mucilage contact mechanics or measured coordinated movement. Optical contrast, forces and speed are unmeasured.

reports.name: Rhodospirillum rubrum
reports.shape: A selected short curved rounded bacterial envelope replaces the generic long corkscrew. Thin visually enlarged polar filament bundles are attached at both poles as a selected motile-DS-type illustration.
reports.surface: A subdued mauve selected envelope and visually enlarged fine polar filament cues replace the old long pink corkscrew. New authentic prepared-cell TEM comparison is credited separately from this uncalibrated colour/material presentation.
reports.remaining: Envelope pigment, curvature, proportions, membrane layers and filament radius/count/pitch are illustrative. The selected three visible filaments per pole are not a biological count. No internal membranes, motor structures, true TEM contrast, strain-specific hydrodynamics or measured propulsion are simulated. Some close views clip the enlarged envelope and suppress its whole-cell curvature.

reports.name: Borrelia burgdorferi
reports.shape: A continuous slender rounded envelope follows a planar flat-wave centerline. It has no exposed polar flagella; internal periplasmic ribbons are discussed as mechanism, not reconstructed molecular anatomy.
reports.surface: A slender continuous neutral envelope carries a planar wave. Source darkfield halos/blue background are retained only in the authentic micrograph and are not treated as living pigment or surface texture.
reports.remaining: The envelope remains smooth and uniform, rounded tip transitions are idealized, and close views can clip a partial wave. Internal periplasmic ribbons, outer membrane ultrastructure and motors are not reconstructed. Waveform, body roll, forces, optical appearance and speed are unmeasured; this is not a physiological or pathogenic-process simulation.

limits: Partly stylized, unmeasured educational reconstructions. Silica/envelope optics, fine ultrastructure, proportions and motion timing remain approximate. No independent specialist validation, accuracy percentage, measured biomechanics, physiological solver or simulated microscopy. Source preparation and taxonomic opinions are explicit.
next: Prepare additional250 under remaining group quotas; further realism/validation remains open.

foreground46.scope: Initial author corrections with authentic references, individual screenshots and explicit residual limitations. Not independent scientific validation, completed photorealism or90percent accuracy. Idle intervals are not active review hours.
